content_sections.heading: ACTREC Medical Officer Application Fee

content_sections.heading: ACTREC Medical Officer Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is conducted through a Walk-In Interview or a Zoom Interview. For Walk-in Interview: Candidates fulfilling requirements may appear for the Walk-In Interview along with Bio-data, a recent passport size photograph, Xerox copies of Aadhar Card, Pan Card, Educational qualification certificates, and Working experience certificates at the above venue within reporting time only. For Online Interview: Candidates may drop in a mail requesting for a Zoom interview at the mail ID: [email protected] . Attach the required documents with the mail, including Bio-data, self-attested copies of certificate regarding date of birth, recent passport size photograph, scanned copies of Aadhar Card, Pan Card, Educational qualification certificates, and Working experience certificates. Ensure the email is sent on or before 15th October, 2026 (Thursday) 05:30 p.m. Attend the interview schedule on 16/10/2026 (Friday).

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Bio-data Recent passport size photograph Aadhar Card (Xerox / Scanned copy) Pan Card (Xerox / Scanned copy) Educational qualification certificates Working experience certificates Certificate regarding date of birth

content_sections.heading: ACTREC Medical Officer Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Venue for Walk-in Interview: Paymaster Shodhika, Administration Department, Room No. PS-330, Advanced Centre for Treatment, Research and Education in Cancer (ACTREC), Sector-22, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai - 410 210. Reporting time for the interview is 10:00 a.m. to 10:30 a.m. The duration of engagement is initially for the period of one year (extendable as per requirement of the Centre). Candidates applying via email must send requests to [email protected] by 15th October, 2026, 05:30 p.m.
